profile.headline: Google Software Engineer | Founder @ ExamAi | Ex Meta | Ex Apple
profile.summary:
Hey guys! My name is Joaquin (Quino for my friends). I am a Software Engineer based in the San Francisco Bay Area. My passions are Augmented Reality, GenAi, and 3D Printing! Over the 7 years, I have shaped my career path anywhere from Software/Hardware Automation to full-stack development of AR/VR and GenAi platforms. 

I recently took a year off to work on my own startup, AR Museum, and get a Master's in Business Analytics from UC Davis with hopes of gaining the knowledge I need to launch businesses at a large scale, focusing on Business impact.

I'm a friendly individual who loves giving career advice and getting involved in making startups from an idea to launch!

www.miniquinox.com

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description:
Development of Artificial Intelligence SAAS Platform for Automated School Grading.

•	Secured $150,000 in credits from Microsoft and $350,000 from Nvidia to support the launch of ExamAi.
•	Developed the AI SAAS platform end-to-end.
•	Led the technology team, overseeing 6 engineers and 4 designers.
•	Created a two-year growth strategy and assigned its execution to an 8-person business team.
•	Built tools to support expansion, including an AI-driven system generating 10,000 automated emails and a comprehensive salary database for U.S. colleges, and automated data visualization dashboards.
positions.insights: Skills: iOS Development · Swift (Programming Language) · Software Infrastructure · Software Development · Selenium · User Interface (UI) Design · Image Recognition · Python (Programming Language) · Database Management · Flutter · Dart · Cloud Automation · Full-Stack Development · Leadership & Team Management · Program Management · Project Management · Cloud Infrastructure · AI/ML Integration · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Firebase Firestore · Fundraising

positions.title: Software Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Developed macOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI to control serial devices, including spectrometers, for scientific and hardware-driven workflows.

•	Engineered scientifically accurate spectral processing scripts in Python and Swift, leveraging spectral math to analyze and process light data from 25 spectrometers in parallel efficiently.
•	Implemented advanced spectral graphs and real-time voltage plotting from Arduino, enabling precise visualization of sensor data.
•	Built automated systems that trigger scripts based on photodiode signals, streamlining measurement workflows and ensuring reliable real-time hardware performance.

positions.title: Lead Software Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Leadership over Software Engineering Support team part of Meta Reality Labs.

•	Software & Hardware Validation using Python and full stack development of Internal Equipment Control mobile app using Flutter, Dart, Swift and Python. 
•	Managed Reality Labs internal Networks and established a 3D printing lab, saving $300k+ annually with CAD Rapid Prototyping, 3D scanning, and diverse 3D printing techniques (FDM, SLA, MJF).
•	Automation of AR/VR headsets, Android devices (using ADB), Linux DevServers, and Network Hosts.
•	Implemented Camera Imaging Simulators in several Multi-GPU Cloud services such as GitHub Actions with AWS EC2 Containers to reduce costs from $1,051,200 to estimated $14,600 per team per year.
•	Research of Camera frustums and Fields of view by creating a 3D automation workflow using Blender Python and CUDA (Nvidia GPUs) for Optical Camera Imaging simulations to create 1M+ GLTF scenes.

positions.title: Full Stack Automation Engineer
positions.description:
IOT Automation Engineer Consultant at Signify Phillips and Halliburton

•	Created automation framework for engineers to test Front-End and Back-End using process parallelization with Python, Selenium, Robot Framework, and Mosquitto API (MQTT). 
•	Front-End Automation by web scraping to test web elements in Halliburton Frac web application.
•	Full-Stack Hardware/Software Automation testing of Wireless Area Connectors made by Signify Phillips.
positions.insights: Skills: Robot Framework · Linux · GitHub · Software Infrastructure · Software Development · Hardware Validation · Bash (Programming Language) · Shell Scripting · Selenium · Python (Programming Language) · Postman · Mosquitto API (MQTT) · Cloud Automation · Software Validation

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Research of Convolutional Neural Networks used for classifying images at large scale.

•	Wrote production-level Python code, trained, and fine-tuned Deep Learning Neural Networks (mostly CNNs) with Machine Learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Numpy, CUDA, and OpenCV. Model GPU computing using multiple Nvidia graphics cards.
•	File management scripting with Python in UNIX/Linux environment via ssh connection to build and organize neural networks on several datasets such as ImageNet, CIFAR10, MNIST, COCO2017, etc.
•	Recreated TensorFlow from scratch to build a proprietary library faster and more efficient, implementing Keras with newer versions of famous models like VGG16, Resnet50, Inception and DenseNet.
positions.insights: Skills: Neural Networks · Dataset Management · CUDA · Keras (Python Library) · Linux · Software Infrastructure · Software Development · Bash (Programming Language) · Shell Scripting · OpenCV · TensorFlow · Python (Programming Language) · Cloud Automation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Quality Assurance and Software Automation of Avionics Hardware equipment.

•	C and Python code review and documentation of test requirements. Assisted with test/validation, software identification, Code Coverage, and requirements checks.
•	Developed code verification by analysis procedures for a DO-178 B Level C project, using Python, C, C++, Shell, and Bash and interacting with hardware for tests. 
•	Script automation with Python and Bash to run multiple programs sequentially as well as file management automation.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ (Programming Language) · Linux · Software Development · Hardware Validation · Bash (Programming Language) · C (Programming Language) · Shell Scripting · Python (Programming Language) · Software Validation

positions.title: Python Instructor
positions.description:
Python instructor through the University of New Mexico at Washington and Polk School in Spanish and English to bilingual students.

•	Coursework taught: Python, Object Oriented, Functions, Libraries, Pyplot, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Bash (Programming Language) · Shell Scripting · Python (Programming Language)
